text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Merry Chriiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Merry Chris!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. Daitaku Helios had 
gathered her crew for a party.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright, Turbo! Let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm on it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Train-P! Don't just stand there 
like a statue!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's the spirit! Aayyy☆

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Me too~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Woah-woah.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Lookin' good~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Woah-woah☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Christmas night passed merrily, 
with Daitaku Helios at the center of it 
all—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Phew~☆ Dat was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Cleanup's all done! Time to head home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Daitaku Helios, I thought she'd 
party all night long... Yet even Mejiro 
Palmer ended up heading home.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's the whole surprise, duh!☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Hanya?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hanya? Hanyahanyaa~??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hanya...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hanya?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Surpriiiiise☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Merry Chris! Aaand thanks for everything, 
as always☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha, from cool-toned to warm-toned☆ 
Trainy, you're hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon opening the present... there were 
colorful bath bombs inside.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're super beat on the regular, right? 
Get hyped with this and hit the shower!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, was that the right answer?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was gonna pack a bunch of 
prank props. Like fake bugs and toy 
snakes! Would've been hilarious, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But Palmer-chin said this one's better~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And! I've still got things to do!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hanya...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, is that wrong? It's better not 
to just go off the vibe, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "*Ahem*. Uhm, Trai-poyo!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Like, we're way past being two of a kind. 
We're basically the same person, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that! We gotta be ourselves, so—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wanna match with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the present I was handed was... 
something with the exact same design as 
the ear covers Daitaku Helios was wearing—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Humans don't cover their ears, right? 
That's why stuff like this exists.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I made sure to put on earrings too! 
Pretty stylish, right? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Daitaku Helios made them by hand. 
But why earmuffs? There are other 
accessories like bangles that could have 
matched the design completely, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You don't have these super cute ears or a 
floofy tail like me, right, Trainy-P?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's why! I'd rather pick something I 
have that you don't, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then it's the same, right? It hasn't 
changed at all!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm tryin' my best to explain it right 
now, ya get it?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's winter right now anyway! Let's do a 
bunch of matching outfits☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And! I've still got things to do!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm inviting Miracle and Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yup!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: There's no point unless both of ya see it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyy☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Where's Miracle? I invited you both 
together!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since you are stopping by the hospital, I 
have been asked to pass along an apology.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this kinda the reverse of how it 
usually goes? That's rare... or wait, I'm 
actually touched!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo is actually coming?! Is this like, a 
historic first?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard that you'll be running in the 
'Arima Kinen'."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, that's it! Just saying you 
should come watch☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Objectively speaking, the chances of 
winning are slim. Why did you decide to 
run?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Because I like Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I like Ruby, right? But Ruby's totally 
down, right??"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it 'cause Miracle's feelin' down??? 
Then we just gotta hype Miracle up, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then perfect's our only choice, right~~?! 
Like, Arima, here we go, kinda vibe!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your explanation, but I don't 
understand a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You'll understand once you see it! Can you 
tell Miracle to make sure she comes too?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' you, I'll make a miracle 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...What are you talking about? Miracles... 
don't exist.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Why? Isn't saying that for sure way more 
impossible?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You never know until you try! Besides, all 
we've got is right now, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody knows what'll happen tomorrow! 
That's why we just gotta go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna make a miracle 
happen! So, come watch!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot believe what you see. Because 
you and I are different—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's not wrong.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, our eyes are meeting. We're 
breathing the same air! You understand the 
meaning of my words, don't you!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know you're different too, right?! 
Then aren't we basically the same?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I don't... understand what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: See! You do know stuff I don't!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if ya believe me or not! I'll 
just make ya understand, that's all!!
